sources.name: ACC Annual Report 2024
sources.assumptions: Levy revenue for FY2024, from each ACC Account's own statement of comprehensive revenue and expense: Earners' Account $2,555m, Work Account $1,037m, Motor Vehicle Account $478m. Treasury's FSGNZ 2024 reports a combined 'ACC levies' line of $4,145m (accrual) - about $75m higher, likely a scope difference between the two publications.

sources.name: Financial Statements of the Government of New Zealand for the year ended 30 June 2024, Notes 4-7
sources.assumptions: FSGNZ fully consolidates SOEs, so several of these are proxies, not exact matches to their label: 'SOE dividends and profits' uses Note 7's general 'Dividends' line ($1,430m), not SOE-specific. 'Investment income' uses Note 6's interest revenue ($7,120m). 'Sale of goods and services' is Note 5's total ($25,135m) an exact match. 'Fees, fines and penalties' sums Note 4's Court fines ($125m) and Child support/WFF penalties ($246m) = $371m.

sources.name: calculate.co.nz - NZ ACC levy rates
sources.assumptions: Current (2026/27 levy year) rates: Earner's Levy $1.75 per $100 of liable earnings; Work Levy $0.69 per $100 of payroll, ACC's own scheme-wide average standing in for over 500 industry-specific Classification Unit rates that range $0.02-$5.77 per $100; Motor Vehicle Levy $131.94 per vehicle per year, ACC's own scheme-wide average across about 10 vehicle classes. Each ACC levy's taxable base above is back-derived as FY2024 revenue divided by these current rates, rather than the (lower) rate actually in effect during FY2024.

sources.name: NZPAM - Mining Industry Statistics
sources.assumptions: Petroleum royalties and energy resource levies combined fell to $123.7m for the year to 30 June 2025 (down 44.4% year-on-year), implying the prior year (approximating FY2024) was ~$222.5m. Treasury separately books 'Energy resources levies' ($21m for FY2024) elsewhere in this project's 'other' residual, so the petroleum-royalties figure above ($201.5m) subtracts that out to avoid double-counting - not an official isolated split, a derived estimate.
